purpose: Teach: 買わ/積ん/はいる/移る/直っ/治り/片付ける/歩ける

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前買わなくていいぜ
lines.en: You don't need to buy that.
lines.style: Quick, casual dismissal. Slight head tilt away. The ease of someone who doesn't need to explain herself to this person. Matter-of-fact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の積んでる漫画貸せよ、桜
lines.en: Lend me those manga you've got piled up, will you?
lines.style: Soft request masked as casual demand. Eyes flick toward her, testing. Leaning against something. The question mark in his voice even though he didn't ask.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.style: Glance back over her shoulder. Mild impatience but not unkind. Movement already forward, expecting him to follow. The tone of someone used to this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、隣の席に移るんだろ?桜
lines.en: You're moving seats next to me, right?
lines.style: Quiet curiosity. Eyes meeting hers briefly before looking away. Trying not to show that he's noticed. The question hangs open a beat longer than it needs to.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前のスマホ直ったな
lines.style: Observational, slightly warm. Looking at him directly. A small acknowledgment of something that mattered to him. Not making a big thing of it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前のお熱、治り早かったな、桜
lines.en: That fever cleared up pretty quick.
lines.style: Gentle observation. Softer than his usual tone. Not quite meeting her eyes but clearly glad. The kind of remark that doubles as checking she's really okay.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、教室を片付けるの手伝えよ
lines.en: Help me clean up the classroom, yeah?
lines.style: Direct but not harsh. Walking toward the task already. A moment of pause that invites him to follow. Expecting him to say yes without question.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、歩ける距離だろ、桜
lines.en: You can walk that far, can't you?
lines.style: Teasing edge underneath genuine warmth. Slight smile in the voice. Close, private tone — this joke is just for him. The care wrapped in casual pushback.
